stable.title: ImageGlass 10: Rebuilt for Speed and Cross-Platform Support
stable.description: This release marks a massive milestone: a complete rewrite from the ground up. ImageGlass 10 is rebuilt on .NET and Avalonia, bringing a single, unified codebase natively to Windows, macOS, and Linux.
